'''Serrok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] Serrok was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where he aided the [[Noble/Legends|Noble]] [[House of Thul]] in [[Assault on Fort Orrus|capturing]] [[Fort Orrus]], a stronghold belonging to the rival [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]]. Serrok was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Republic forces that reclaimed the fort.

==Biography==
Serrok was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] loyal to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Sith Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the war and during the [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] there, which took place during the Cold War, Serrok aided the Imperial aligned [[Noble/Legends|Noble]] [[House of Thul]]. He joined Thul troops lead by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Varus Thul]], in the [[Assault on Fort Orrus|conquest]] of [[Fort Orrus]], a stronghold of the Republic aligned [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]]. Serrok and his men successfully destroyed the Fort's defenses and [[Death/Legends|killed]] or captured the Organa troops garrisoned there.<ref name="TOR" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Serrok was killed<ref name="TOR" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Time" /> by Republic forces that reclaimed Fort Orrus for House Organa.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Serrok was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and often [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choked]] enemies in combat. He had [[Color/Legends|white]] skin, black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
Serrok wore red [[Armor/Legends|armor]] in combat and wielded a single&ndash;handed red bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Serrok first appeared as an enemy in the quest "Reclaiming Fort Orrus" with in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].
